WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(1.0 * ss.boxy / ss.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
source_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept_sources AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.record_count, a.avg_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN source_average AS a
  WHERE s.record_count > a.avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_record_count,
  AVG(record_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM kept_sources;
